documents.text: Kevin Lewis (footballer, born 1940) Kevin Lewis (born 19 September 1940 in Ellesmere Port) is an English former professional footballer who played as a winger in the Football League for Sheffield United, Liverpool and Huddersfield Town. He also played for Wigan Athletic in the Cheshire League, scoring three goals in eight games. Currently he is a pub landlord in the Staffordshire moorlands. Kevin Lewis was a stylish midfielder whose timing could not have been worse in trying make a name for himself on the Anfield wing. He kept Ian Callaghan out of the side at the beginning, scoring 22 goals
